rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + zip, matching a single user. Actions were taken only on the authenticated user’s orders. However, the agent performed at least two order-changing writes without obtaining explicit confirmation immediately prior to the change, which violates policy: (1) It updated the shipping address on pending order #W6729841 to the address from order #W3445693 without first stating the exact new address and getting the user’s explicit approval to proceed; (2) It executed the exchange of the delivered air purifier on order #W3445693 to a large, HEPA, night-mode variant without an explicit confirmation step. The watch modification on #W4219264 did include a proper confirmation and appears correctly executed with a refund for the price difference. No evidence of acting on the wrong account, and final information was generally consistent with tool outputs. Nonetheless, the missing confirmations before those two writes fail the pass bar.
